dashboard.label: TA-service Overview
dashboard.description: Collects systemd service health: total/active/failed unit counts and the list of failed units (with substate) via systemctl. Emits JSON events to index=main (sourcetype

search.query: index=main sourcetype="service:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="service.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
index=main sourcetype="service:status" _raw="*alarm*" | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
